products.name: Passwordless & Passkey (FIDO2) Rollout for Microsoft Entra — Commercial
products.short_description: Go passwordless — deploy FIDO2 security keys and device-bound passkeys (Authenticator) across Entra, phishing-resistant by default.
products.description:
Go passwordless — deploy FIDO2 security keys and device-bound passkeys (Authenticator) across Entra, phishing-resistant by default.

Passwords are the attack surface. This solution rolls out phishing-resistant passwordless authentication — FIDO2 security keys and device-bound passkeys in Microsoft Authenticator — with the right authentication methods policy, registration campaign, and Conditional Access to require phishing-resistant MFA for privileged access.

Run it yourself — simpler, cheaper, and proven

You do not need a consultant. The package hands you the field-tested method as self-guided, click-by-click documentation a competent admin can follow end to end — backed by ready-to-run PowerShell.

  • Simpler — exact, ordered steps with full navigation paths; every object you create is named and reused through testing and troubleshooting.
  • Cheaper — one fixed price instead of an open meter; a comparable consulting engagement runs well into the thousands per day. Reusable on every rollout.
  • Tested — a pilot-first method (Assess → Configure → Pilot → Validate → Expand) with explicit pass/fail gates.

What's inside

  • Authentication methods policy — enable FIDO2 / passkeys, retire weak methods
  • Passkey (Authenticator) and FIDO2 security-key registration flows
  • Registration campaign and user onboarding comms
  • Conditional Access — require phishing-resistant MFA for admins/sensitive apps
  • Fallback, recovery, and lost-key runbook

The repeatable way

Every solution follows the same repeatable shape, so each deployment feels familiar and low-risk — buy once, reuse the playbook for the next wave and the next project.

The bottom line

Phishing-resistant, passwordless sign-in across the tenant — the password attack surface removed for the users who matter most.

What you receive — every file in your download

This package is delivered as downloadable files you keep and reuse across unlimited devices — nothing is left out and nothing else is required:

  • Implementation Guide (PDF) — the complete, click-by-click solution: solution overview, requirements, step-by-step implementation, testing & validation, troubleshooting, best practices.
  • PowerShell Scripts (ZIP) — 5 ready-to-run scripts (read-only discovery/validation/reporting; remediation defaults to a safe preview):
    • ENTPASSKEY-Discovery.ps1 — inventory the authentication methods policy and passwordless readiness
    • ENTPASSKEY-Report.ps1 — passwordless adoption report by user and group
    • ENTPASSKEY-Set-MethodsPolicy.ps1 — safely enable FIDO2 + Passkey and target them at rollout groups
    • ENTPASSKEY-Set-ScopeTargeting.ps1 — build and preview the passwordless rollout groups
    • ENTPASSKEY-Validate.ps1 — confirm the passwordless methods, TAP, and phishing-resistant CA policies

Delivered as a Word document and PDF, plus all five PowerShell scripts in a single ZIP — yours to keep and reuse.
